sanitizer.scope: full production Fmp4V2Bridge / ResourceSource / lease registry

linuxInstallation.scope: Atomic replacement with backup of verified Linux EXE and bundled V2 client; all remaining files preserved

initialRuns.cause: Test assumed one verify call scans all already hashed bytes. ResourceSource uses bounded rotating audits. Corrected the test to request the modified payload block from the decoder path and verify rejection before byte delivery; final native and sanitizer runs passed.

limits: Little-endian RIFF/WAVE format tag 1, packed signed PCM24, mono/stereo 44.1/48 kHz; 16-byte fmt or 18-byte fmt with cbSize 0
Known RIFF/data sizes and one final aligned nonempty data chunk; odd data padding excluded from PCM
No RF64, WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE, float, other bit depths/rates/layouts, multiple data chunks or trailing bytes
Explicit PCM24 opt-in; existing WAV PCM16 capability and sowt adapter unchanged
Internal virtual QuickTime version-1 in24 + wave/enda=1 stream preserves all three bytes per sample
Sample clocks and packet indices exact; sample-exact UI seek and bit-exact physical device output not claimed
Installed Windows applications unchanged; SDK ZIP contains no updated EXE/MSI installers
Full audio matrix, long-run stress and real Harvester integration remain open
